source.title: Symptoms and treatment response to florensocatib and inhaled tobramycin in bronchiectasis: Post hoc analysis of two randomized trials

limitations: Extraction prioritizes independently reviewable study design, population, treatment, major efficacy, symptom-domain, limitation, and provenance assertions; it does not atomize every baseline table cell or every nonsignificant supplemental symptom-domain time point.
Supplement-derived assertions retain supplement locators and are not represented as separate publications.
Calculated percentage-point responder differences are explicitly marked calculated_from_reported_data.
